title: Squirrel wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M62 62 Q82 58 82 38 Q82 20 66 22 Q54 24 56 38 Q57 48 64 50 Q70 46 68 38 Q67 32 62 34' fill='#d97a2e' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='17' ry='19' fill='#e08a3c' stroke='#f7b46b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#ffe0b3'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='14' fill='#e08a3c' stroke='#f7b46b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='33' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e08a3c' stroke='#f7b46b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='33' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e08a3c' stroke='#f7b46b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='33' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#ffb47a'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='33' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#ffb47a'/>
  <!-- Muzzle / cheeks -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ffe0b3'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ffe0b3'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='2.4' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='2.4' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='41.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='41.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='1.8' fill='#8a3d12'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 49 Q47 52 45 50 M50 49 Q53 52 55 50' fill='none' stroke='#8a3d12' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='72' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- Acorn held -->
  <g transform='translate(50 62)'>
    <ellipse cx='0' cy='3' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
    <path d='M-3.4 1 Q0 -2 3.4 1 Q0 2.5 -3.4 1 Z' fill='#8a4a12'/>
    <rect x='-0.6' y='-3' width='1.2' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#8a4a12'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <path d='M50 12 L39 30 L61 30 Z' fill='#3ec6e0' stroke='#8de8f7' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <path d='M42.5 25 L57.5 25' stroke='#ff5fa2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M45 19.5 L55 19.5' stroke='#ffd93b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Hat brim band -->
  <rect x='38' y='29' width='24' height='3.5' rx='1.7' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
</svg>
